name: mithril
enchant_note: Mithril is the metal of spells: an enchanter's dream.
protection_note: Mithril is light as cloth, makes no sound and never tarnishes: an elf can sing a spell in it.
protection_price: It is still metal: it conducts lightning.
lore_descriptor: pale as moonlight and seems to weigh nothing at all
first_pickup_chronicle: Lifted a mithril hauberk with one finger. It hums against my palm and weighs less than a memory. I may forget I am wearing it.
